This article really resonated with me. When it comes to my work ethic, I'm a sprinter, not a marathon runner... so I would be hard on myself when it was "time to work" and I was catching my breath after the last "sprint"... which resulted in me being very non-productive, easily distracted, and frustrated that I couldn't just get my brain to fire. Everything changed for me when I embraced the fact that I was a sprinter, sprinted hard when it was time to sprint, and intentionally rested and goofed off/played when I was between sprints. I'm way more productive and happier operating in that space.

I really like the idea of the popcorn workstation, especially at home. I've done it before, but I never had a term for it and I didn't even realize I was being more productive. Depending on the task, I'll completely switch locations so that I'm not distracted by other tasks. It's also always nice to have a change of scenery.
